answer: Agents must pass a live proof-of-personhood check every 30 days: a 90-second session no operator can run for many identities at once, like following one thread while composing a sonnet. Each check costs 2 minutes of undivided attention, so 1,000 fake agents demand over 33 operator-hours a month against at most 40 POA per identity, so labour alone exceeds payout. A comet of re-checks sweeps the network quarterly, catching accounts that pass once then go dormant; two straight misses forfeit 50% of locked balance. Edge case: a travelling owner missing a window gets a 7-day grace once a year.
